question: Which public reset-start contract should own prompt text customization across ordinary chat resets, reply-producing reset turns, Gateway agent resets, bootstrap-pending flows, and per-agent configuration?
rationale: The request is technically clear, but choosing `session.resetPrompt`, an `agents.defaults.startupContext` extension, or a broader reset policy changes public config shape and session-start semantics across multiple paths.

options.title: Choose One Reset-Start Policy
options.body: Define a single typed policy that covers prompt replacement, acknowledgement-only mode, startup-turn behavior, bootstrap/current-time safeguards, and per-agent overrides before implementation.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Text Only
options.body: Approve a narrow prompt-text key and explicitly preserve current acknowledgement/model-routing behavior while documenting which built-in prompt sections remain non-overridable.

options.title: Decline A New Prompt Key
options.body: Keep the current hardcoded reset-start prompt and direct users to existing startup context, reset hooks, or explicit `/new <message>` workflows.

recommendation.title: Choose One Reset-Start Policy
recommendation.body: Define a single typed policy that covers prompt replacement, acknowledgement-only mode, startup-turn behavior, bootstrap/current-time safeguards, and per-agent overrides before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current acknowledgement-only reset contract and is already in the issue timeline for the reset-start discussion.
